If it lies on the path between vi l and x ′1 (resp. between vi l and v 1′ ), then we have a path from vi l to x ′ (resp. between vi l and v ′ ) which has length smaller than d(vi l, x ′ ) (resp. d(vi l, v ′ )), which is a contradiction.
